preconditions.description: The number of steps n is between 1 and 10^6.
The length of the string s is equal to n.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'UD' for c in s)
preconditions.description: Each character in the string s is either 'U' or 'D'.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly n numbers.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(x, int) for x in output)
postconditions.description: Each element in the output is an integer.

postconditions.expression: all(x > 0 or x == -1 for x in output)
postconditions.description: Each element in the output is either a positive integer or -1.
